story_title: A Safe Wait at Riverside Station
paragraphs: A serious emergency causes a temporary closure at Riverside subway station. Staff guide passengers to the main hall while medical responders help someone on the platform. Station officer Lee makes a calm announcement. "Please wait here {{mask_1}} a staff member directs you elsewhere. You may leave through Exit A {{mask_2}} it remains open."

Nora is traveling with her younger brother, Ben. She tells him, "Stay beside me {{mask_3}} a station worker asks us to move. We can follow the signs {{mask_4}} we walk and do not run." Lee reminds everyone, "Do not go back to the platform {{mask_5}} staff say it is safe. You may use the benches {{mask_6}} you keep the walkway clear."

A passenger is worried because she cannot find her friend. Lee says, "You can wait near the information desk {{mask_7}} you tell a staff member where you are. Please do not enter the closed area {{mask_8}} a worker opens it." Nora offers to help the passenger contact her friend. Lee says, "You may use your phone {{mask_9}} you keep the station entrance clear."

The station provides another announcement with simple directions. "Passengers can take the north exit {{mask_10}} it is marked open. Please stay in the main hall {{mask_11}} a staff member gives you different directions." Ben asks whether they can sit down. Nora replies, "We can sit here {{mask_12}} we leave space for people who need assistance."

After a short time, an employee tells passengers that Exit A is open and the platform remains closed. Lee says, "You may leave with your group {{mask_13}} you follow the signs. Do not return for a forgotten item {{mask_14}} station staff say the area is safe." Nora and Ben walk toward the exit together. "We can stop by the help desk {{mask_15}} we need more information," Nora says.

Outside the station, staff direct people to a nearby bus stop. Nora checks that Ben is with her. Lee tells the crowd, "You may wait at the bus stop {{mask_16}} you keep the sidewalk clear. Please stay with your group {{mask_17}} a staff member tells you the service has changed." A worker adds, "You can ask us for directions {{mask_18}} you need help. The bus will stop here {{mask_19}} the road remains open." Nora thanks the staff. She and Ben wait calmly {{mask_20}} the stop remains open to passengers.
